text: Use the original's images by default; they are in brand/brand.md. If the original shows a video or an image that is not in brand/brand.md, use the closest brand image, and say so in your report.
note: The section-level half of P11; how a video is carried belongs to family 3.

text: Keep the original's layout: columns, order, alignment, where images sit, and the rhythm of spacing.
Compare with `compare_section`… Fix what looks clearly different, and compare again. Stop when it reads as the same section, or after three comparisons.
Use when you are asked to rebuild one of the seller's captured sections as a component.
note: R4.3: the agent itself rebuilds a clone when the material needs more room than its slots; M1.2: rebuild to carry motion.

text: The seller's captured sections (clones) are frozen: only some of their words can change. A rebuilt section is a component that looks like the original but holds all of its content in props, so a page can change any word, image, link or item.
